name: n8n AI News Briefing
summary: Concept: collect industry updates, summarise the useful stories, and prepare a daily briefing.
description: An illustrative n8n workflow design concept for a daily AI-assisted news digest. This is not a deployed product or client case study. The cover is a reference screenshot from n8n documentation.
role: Workflow concept and proposed integration design
technologies: Proposed: n8n, RSS, HTTP APIs, Ollama, Telegram, scheduled triggers
challenge: Following several feeds manually makes it easy to miss useful updates or repeatedly read the same story.
approach: Proposed flow: run on a daily schedule, collect permitted RSS or API sources, deduplicate links, generate concise source-linked summaries, and prepare a digest for review before optional delivery. The n8n documentation cover demonstrates a related news workflow; it is reference material rather than evidence of this project being implemented.
features: Human review before optional Telegram delivery
imageAlt: Reference screenshot from n8n documentation showing its AI workflow builder configuring a news briefing; not a screenshot of this proposed portfolio project
imageCredit: Reference image: n8n documentation. This project is a design concept.
